messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high-sev observability gap for customer corpnova (VPC). Missing traces and delayed log ingestion for tenant corpnova-prod. Incident created INC-2026-0345. First seen at 1987654321. @raj-patel
Raj Patel: I'm on it. seeing 5xx spikes from dedicated pool serving corpnova-prod, traces for several requests are absent in jaeger. p95 trace latency shows big gaps -- spans never arrive.
Maria Chen: confirming. metrics for corpnova-prod look normal (requests in), but the trace/span counts dropped ~10:03 UTC. Logs are lagging behind by ~7–10m in the forwarder queue.
Raj Patel: any config change this morning? committed a forwarder tweak at 09:58 but only for another tenant. checking forwarder logs now.
Ops SRE: I'm pulling forwarder metrics. queue depth for corp-forwarder-prod is elevated and last successful POST to obs-collector was 09:55. getting 403s intermittently from collector (auth).
Maria Chen: 403 from collector -> likely role/token expiry or principal scoping on the VPC-side IAM. corpnova uses a customer-managed forwarder in their VPC (private deployment).
Tanvi Rao: pinging corpnova SRE (external) to confirm they didn't rotate creds. @jake_morales can you prepare a short-lived role we can grant for debug?
Jake Morales: creating a temp assume-role for oncall. policy: ``{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"s3:GetObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::corpnova-forwarder-logs/*"}]
}`` TTL 1h. I'll post ARN after creation. :white_check_mark:
Raj Patel: thanks. meanwhile can we enable fallback path to hosted-collector for corpnova-prod? we have policy in place to route to hosted for emergencies but it's gated by tenant allowlist.
Ops SRE: I can toggle allowlist but need approval from product for customer-facing changes. this is a live mitigation path: reroute traffic -> hosted collector; will drop VPC-local retention guarantees (customer aware).
Maria Chen: customer impact note: traces missing means distributed tracing for corpnova-prod is degraded; logs delayed means support cannot correlate incidents. metadata (request ids) still present in metrics so functional impact is limited to observability only. documented in INC-2026-0345.
Raj Patel: corpnova-prod has ded. GPU pool but that shouldn't affect traces. root cause vector: forwarder->collector auth failing -> queue buildup -> sampling/time-window drop -> spans never persisted.
SupportBot: Added customer-facing status update draft to INC-2026-0345: "We are investigating an observability ingestion issue affecting traces and logs for corpnova-prod. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
Tanvi Rao: corpnova SRE responded: they did not rotate creds; they see 403 on their egress logs too. they asked to avoid hosted reroute unless necessary.
Jake Morales: temp role created: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-temporary-debug-1987654321 (TTL 60m). Use aws sts assume-role to pull forwarder logs. posted in #secure-ops.
Raj Patel: using the temp role now. pulling last 200 lines from forwarder: ``HTTP 403 response from collector: {"error":"invalid_client"} -> token validation failed at 09:55:12``
Ops SRE: collector logs show periodic auth failures for corpnova tenant principal mismatch against the collector's allowlist. recent deploy of collector auth logic (rolling 08:52) tightened issuer validation.
Maria Chen: so collector deploy + VPC principal scoping exposed existing expired/loose tokens for corpnova. corpnova's forwarder is still using older token format.
Raj Patel: mitigation plan: 1) ask corpnova to rotate to new issuer token (they're already internal SRE looped) 2) temporarily open allowlist for old token for 30m while we drain queue 3) if customer declines, enable hosted fallback for missed spans and replay logs once auth is fixed.
Tanvi Rao: corpnova ops okayed a 20m allowlist window to drain but asked for audit log entry. I'll author the audit and put RBAC changes in change-control.
Ops SRE: making allowlist change now. ``/infractl collector allowlist add corpnova-old-token --ttl 1200 --audit "INC-2026-0345"``
IncidentBot: Change requested: allowlist add - in progress (run started at 1987654402).
Maria Chen: I'm monitoring span ingestion. queue depth dropping. new spans visible but with ~4m delay. confirming trace continuity is returning for a sample corpus.
Raj Patel: started partial drain replay: triggering forwarder replay job for last 30m. command: ``/forwarder replay --tenant corpnova-prod --from -00:30 --to now`` Using low-rate mode to avoid overload.
SupportBot: Customer status updated: "We are enabling a temporary configuration to drain queued diagnostic data; this may temporarily change retention guarantees. No user-facing functionality is impacted at this time."
Jake Morales: replay in progress. estimated finish ~1987654470. monitoring for errors.
Ops SRE: watcher: no 403s since allowlist change. collector accepted POSTs at 1987654410 onward.
Maria Chen: traces and logs backfilled for most requests. reopening traces dashboard for corpnova-prod p95 shows return to baseline by 1987654478.
Raj Patel: switching incident to recovery phase. next steps: 1) ensure corpnova rotates to new token format (assigned to corpnova SRE) 2) revoke temp debug role at TTL expiry 3) create post-incident action: runbook gap where collector deploy tightened issuer validation without tenant notification. 4) confirm with product the hosted fallback policy and customer consent flows.
Tanvi Rao: I'll schedule a follow-up call with corpnova tomorrow and own the RCA doc. tagging product for the hosted fallback policy review. :memo:
SupportBot: Incident INC-2026-0345 status -> mitigated. last_message 1987654500.
Raj Patel: good job team. adding P1 blameless notes to the incident. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: leaving notes for oncall rotation handoff to next shift.
Ops SRE: revoking allowlist entry now that drain complete. ``/infractl collector allowlist remove corpnova-old-token --audit "INC-2026-0345"`` :white_check_mark:
Jake Morales: temp role will auto-expire. I'll still check and explicitly revoke earlier if needed.
SupportBot: Post-mortem checklist created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0345/pm
Raj Patel: handoff to next oncall @Tanvi Rao. I'm off in 10.
